npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

ai/npc/Teleports/GatekeeperSpirit/31111-.text: Gatekeeper Spirit: The Seal of Avarice is sleeping. You may not pass.

ai/npc/Teleports/GatekeeperSpirit/31111..text: Gatekeeper Spirit: Behold, the sphere speaks... You have entered the Forbidden Sanctum, resting place of Lilith and Anakim . I guard the path to the Sanctum. The Seal of Avarice may only be breached when the eye is open.
